description: This file defines the interface for the EicPresentation module, which manages cryptographic operations, access control, and certificate handling for Android's identity hardware. It includes structure definitions, function prototypes for key generation, authentication, certificate management, and access control validation.

classes.name: EicPresentation
classes.description: A structure encapsulating cryptographic keys, authentication tokens, access control states, and CBOR data for managing identity presentation operations.

methods.name: eicPresentationInit
methods.description: Initializes an EicPresentation context with optional test credential flag and document type.

methods.name: eicPresentationGenerateSigningKeyPair
methods.description: Generates a signing key pair and outputs the public key certificate and signing key blob.

methods.name: eicPresentationCreateEphemeralKeyPair
methods.description: Creates an ephemeral ECDSA key pair, storing the private key in the context.

methods.name: eicPresentationStartRetrieveEntries
methods.description: Begins retrieval of entries from the identity hardware.

methods.name: eicPresentationSetAuthToken
methods.description: Sets the authentication token with challenge, user ID, and verification data.

methods.name: eicPresentationPushReaderCert
methods.description: Pushes a reader's X.509 certificate into the context for validation.

methods.name: eicPresentationValidateAccessControlProfile
methods.description: Validates an access control profile against the current context and reader certificate chain.

methods.name: eicPresentationValidateRequestMessage
methods.description: Validates that a request message is signed by the reader's public key.

methods.name: eicPresentationCalcMacKey
methods.description: Calculates the MAC key for secure communication based on session and key data.

methods.name: eicPresentationStartRetrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Begins retrieval of a specific entry's value with access control checks.

methods.name: eicPresentationRetrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified entry, decrypting and verifying as needed.

methods.name: eicPresentationFinishRetrieval
methods.description: Completes retrieval by computing the HMAC-SHA256 of the data.

methods.name: eicPresentationDeleteCredential
methods.description: Signs and returns a proof of credential deletion.

methods.name: eicPresentationProveOwnership
methods.description: Signs and returns proof of credential ownership.
